title.narrative: Multisectoral Emergency Response Project in Kedaduma Woreda, Dawa Zone of Somali Region

description.narrative: ltpgtASDEPO is proposing an integrated multi sector emergency response for crisis affected communities in Kedaduma Woreda, Dawa zone of Somali Region to address the existing dire humanitarian needs using EHF 2023 1st round reserve allocation fund to save lives. ASDEPO will integrate WaSH, Agriculture, Protection and Cash response activities in the woreda aiming to address the specific challenges of the affected communities following the EHF Area Based Approach. The proposed activities and the proportion of budget allocation for each sector aligns with the 2023 1st RA strategy allocation paper. ASDEPO is currently implementing various activities in Kedaduma woreda and the humanitarian conditions needs additional resources and partner capacities. Protection, Agriculture, WaSH and livelihoods response are among the critically flagged response gaps. The response will improve resilience of the target population through contributing for the improvement of their livelihood, WaSH, protection, and by creating access to cash to fulfill the immediate needs. Cross cutting issues will be meaningfully integrated and supported with budget.lt/pgtltp class="" style=""gtltbrgtlt/pgtltp style="" class=""gtThe project is planned to be implemented in collaboration with Nexus Ethiopia and Imagine1day to use their sectorial expertise on protection and WaSH respectively. ASDEPO will also manage the implementation of Cash response and Agriculture activities. The project will be implemented in close collaboration and complementarity among the implementing partners and the government stakeholders. As part of the localization of aid efforts, ASDEPO is demonstrating strong capacities and it is will work to enhance the organizational capacity of Nexus Ethiopia, a national partner. Imagine 1day an international NGO partner will scale up its good practices and best performances on WaSH and closely collaborate towards the attainment of the project objectives. ASDEPO and the partners will ensure proper monitoring and evaluation activities to inform program management decisions with evidence from the field. Government counterparts will also conduct joint monitoring sessions periodically. ASDEPO and the implementing partners are active in the cluster system at national and sub national level. The active reporting of project activities to the donor and the clusters via Activity Info will be strengthened.nbsp The project duration is 10 months’ period and the total budget of the project is 838,824.04 USD. Through this budget the project will directly reach persons in need directly of which 49,806 persons of which 31,591 are women and girls and 350 are Persons With Disability (PWDs)ltspan class="font11"gtltspan style="font-size:12.0ptmso-bidi-font-size:11.0pt line-height:107%"gtlt/spangtlt/spangtlt/pgtltp class="sceditor-nlf"gtltbrgtlt/pgt
